messages.content: Analyze the concrete failed tests before repairing code. Return concise JSON with root_causes, required_changes, concrete_counterexample_simulation and preserved_invariants (arrays of short strings). Maximum6 entries per array, each at most300characters. Explain actual expected/observed differences, including boolean guards, extra fields/items and ordered arrays. Simulate actual failing inputs; do not copy source/tests or write implementation. Do not modify or dispute independent tests. A repair must change the cause of each repeated failure, not merely rephrase comments.
